The mapped family is named data_table publicly but cites Radix Table. The recipe maps size and variant onto cell padding, minimum cell height, typography, radius, the gray-a5 row divider, bold column headers, and the surface panel, border, gray-a2 header background, and suppressed last-row divider.

Radix Table is a passive layout. Controlled sorting, page-scoped selection, pagination, row hover, arbitrary row actions, and horizontal scrolling are Flutter and Fortal extensions with no Radix counterpart, built from existing accent and gray control tokens.

Radix row-header cells use normal weight, but Flutter 3.44 exposes no row-header semantics role and the v1 data-driven API carries no row-header model, so .rt-TableRowHeaderCell is cited and deferred instead of fabricated.
Row background and divider are painted per cell exactly as .rt-TableCell does upstream, because Flutter's Table has no widget between the table and its cells.
deferredCapabilities: row-header cells (.rt-TableRowHeaderCell): Flutter has no row-header semantics role and the v1 data-driven API has no row-header model
responsive size and layout objects: Radix resolves breakpoints in CSS while Flutter callers rebuild with a different size
per-row align and per-cell width, min-width, max-width, and padding props: expressed as column-level TableColumnWidth, column alignment, and cell widgets instead
layout auto versus fixed: RenderTable always negotiates one shared column map

unmappedUpstreamFamilies.supportedRemixComposition: Use RemixCheckboxGroup for selection, roving focus, semantics, and layout transparency; render each option as FortalCheckboxGroupItem(size:, variant:, highContrast:), which maps the checkbox recipe, size-linked text1/text2/text3 label typography, and scaled 6/7/8 item-label gaps. The caller continues to own root direction and spacing. Callers that need a per-item override can pass a CheckboxStyler to RemixCheckboxGroupItem.style directly.
unmappedUpstreamFamilies.reason: RemixCheckboxGroup deliberately owns no visual or root-layout anatomy, so generating a FortalCheckboxGroup wrapper would invent a root style surface that the underlying coordinator does not have. FortalCheckboxGroupItem maps the item-level typography, label gap, and checkbox visuals independently.
unmappedUpstreamFamilies.reopenCondition: Map the remaining root contract only if RemixCheckboxGroup gains layout anatomy that can express the pinned root direction and gap without a Fortal-only wrapper.

approximations.upstream: Radix Dialog with modal=false permits background pointer interaction while the content is open.
approximations.flutter: RemixDialog with modal=false disables modal accessibility route scoping, but showRemixDialog remains a RawDialogRoute whose barrier blocks background pointer input.
approximations.reason: Flutter Navigator dialog routes are modal routes; non-modal pointer interaction requires a separate OverlayEntry lifecycle rather than the current dialog route API.
approximations.tolerance: Interaction-model boundary only; no visual tolerance. The route barrier and both accessibility modes are covered by dialog_widget_test.dart.

approximations.upstream: Radix Themes uses CSS absolute positioning and size-specific conditional offsets for checkbox, radio, submenu, and trailing content geometry.
approximations.flutter: Remix uses the exact pinned check and chevron paths, colors, sizes, and states with one private leading flex slot and normal MenuItemStyler spacing.
approximations.reason: Standard MenuItemStyler flex, padding, and spacing keep the layout reusable and avoid menu-only public gutter and offset APIs.
approximations.tolerance: Pixel placement of the leading choice slot and trailing-content spacing may differ; behavior, semantics, paths, colors, sizes, state precedence, directionality, and panel-end alignment have no tolerance.

approximations.upstream: Radix moves one selected indicator between items with a 100 ms translated transition.
approximations.flutter: Each selected Remix segment paints the pinned inset fill and ring or classic shadow directly in its own standard container-effects layers.
approximations.reason: A shared translated indicator requires a Fortal-specific render or widget layer outside the plain-styler recipe contract.
approximations.tolerance: The settled selected geometry, fill, ring, shadows, focus, and disabled layers have no tolerance; only the 100 ms movement between items is absent.

approximations.upstream: Radix duplicates each item label and crossfades the inactive and active copies as selection moves.
approximations.flutter: Remix resolves one label from regular to medium weight with the pinned active letter spacing through widget-state variants.
approximations.reason: Duplicate labels would require private stacked label widgets instead of the component's standard LabelStyleMixin surface.
approximations.tolerance: Resolved inactive and active typography has no tolerance; the intermediate label crossfade is absent, and changing an item's displayed label with the selection may cause a small intrinsic-width shift.

approximations.upstream: Radix draws separators between adjacent inactive segments and hides them around the selected indicator.
approximations.flutter: Remix keeps the exact track and item surfaces without separator pseudo-elements.
approximations.reason: Conditional between-item pseudo-elements are not expressible through the standard item styler without a segmented-control-specific widget API.
approximations.tolerance: A one-pixel inactive separator may be absent; segment sizing, spacing, state colors, and selected geometry have no tolerance.

approximations.upstream: Radix pins `min-width: max-content` on the root, so labels never wrap and the track overflows a parent narrower than its content.
approximations.flutter: RemixSegmentedControl divides the available main extent equally, and the Fortal recipe holds each label to one line with an ellipsis.
approximations.reason: The equal-segment render layout shrinks to the incoming constraints rather than forcing an overflow, so a wrapped label would be clipped by the pinned track height.
approximations.tolerance: Only a label narrower than its natural text truncates with an ellipsis; at or above the natural track width every label, metric, and layer is exact.

approximations.upstream: Radix's alternate-reverse animation phase begins on gray-a4 and animates toward gray-a3.
approximations.flutter: RemixSkeleton starts and rests on gray-a3, then pulses toward gray-a4.
approximations.reason: The shared Flutter phase controller uses the resolved container color as its stable initial and resting value.
approximations.tolerance: Only the starting phase direction differs; the gray-a3 and gray-a4 endpoints and the one-second leg timing remain exact.

approximations.upstream: Radix exposes responsive CSS resize values none, vertical, horizontal, and both with a browser drag handle.
approximations.flutter: RemixTextArea uses Flutter constraints, minLines, maxLines, and platform scrolling and exposes no web drag handle.
approximations.reason: Flutter's editable text contract has no cross-platform browser resize-handle primitive.
approximations.tolerance: No drag handle or user resize gesture is expected; variant, size, state, padding, typography, and minimum-height visuals have no tolerance.

approximations.upstream: Radix applies fixed CSS textarea sizing, browser overflow behavior, and a themed 12px scrollbar inside the root.
approximations.flutter: The default RemixTextArea maxLines is null, so content auto-grows until parent constraints require platform scrolling.
approximations.reason: Flutter's line and constraint model replaces CSS block sizing and native textarea overflow behavior.
approximations.tolerance: Content-driven height may differ after the pinned minimum height; the 48, 64, and 80 logical-pixel minimums and all resolved insets have no tolerance.

approximations.upstream: Radix exposes compositional Root, Item, Label, and Value children.
approximations.flutter: RemixDataList accepts data-driven RemixDataListItem rows with either a string value or one custom child value.
approximations.reason: The Remix API guarantees one shared label column and deterministic list semantics through a data model rather than arbitrary child anatomy.
approximations.tolerance: Supported string and custom-child rows preserve their visual geometry and semantics; arbitrary interleaving or nesting of label/value parts is not supported.

approximations.upstream: Radix Label accepts per-label color, highContrast, and width props.
approximations.flutter: FortalDataList exposes one global highContrast recipe argument and caller widgets handle exceptional label content or width needs.
approximations.reason: The data-driven RemixDataList has one shared label styler and shared column width, with no per-label visual-prop surface.
approximations.tolerance: Global gray-a11 or high-contrast gray-12 roles and the 120 logical-pixel minimum have no tolerance; heterogeneous label colors and widths are deferred.

approximations.upstream: Radix accepts responsive objects for root orientation and size, item alignment, trim, and label width.
approximations.flutter: Flutter callers rebuild RemixDataList, RemixDataListItem, and FortalDataList with values selected by their responsive layout.
approximations.reason: Responsive CSS-object syntax is a framework-level adaptation already owned by Flutter layout builders.
approximations.tolerance: No visual tolerance after the caller selects equivalent values; automatic CSS breakpoint switching is outside the recipe.

approximations.upstream: Radix leading trim uses pseudo-content baselines and negative quarter-em value margins with first/last-row exceptions.
approximations.flutter: Remix uses Flutter text baselines for horizontal rows and untrimmed box bounds for vertical and custom-child rows.
approximations.reason: Flutter has no CSS leading-trim primitive, and offset arithmetic is outside the plain-styler recipe contract.
approximations.tolerance: Text ink may sit up to 0.25em differently at row edges; shared columns, gaps, alignment selection, typography, and semantic bounds have no tolerance.

approximations.upstream: Radix nudges the key cap up by `top: -0.03em` with `position: relative` and aligns it with `vertical-align: text-top`.
approximations.flutter: FortalKbd paints the pinned cap geometry, fills, and six-layer classic shadow stack in normal flow.
approximations.reason: A transform wrapper for a sub-pixel baseline tweak sits outside the plain-styler recipe contract, and a standalone Flutter box has no inline text run to align against.
approximations.tolerance: Vertical placement inside a surrounding line may differ by up to 0.03em; font size, letter spacing, minimum width, padding, radius, fills, and every shadow layer have no tolerance.

approximations.upstream: Radix sets `text-decoration-thickness: min(2px, max(1px, 0.05em))` and `text-underline-offset: calc(0.025em + 2px)`.
approximations.flutter: The recipe sets decorationThickness to the same `min(2, max(1, 0.05 x fontSize))` ramp and leaves the underline at the font offset.
approximations.reason: Flutter expresses decorationThickness as a multiple of the font underline thickness and offers no underline-offset property.
approximations.tolerance: Underline offset and absolute stroke width may differ by a fraction of a logical pixel; the breakpoints of the ramp, the decoration line, style, and colour have no tolerance.

approximations.upstream: Radix blends the underline colour with `color-mix(in oklab, var(--accent-aN), var(--gray-a6))`.
approximations.flutter: The recipe blends the same two resolved tokens with an sRGB Color.lerp at 0.5.
approximations.reason: Flutter has no OKLab colour-mix primitive, and shipping one for a single decoration colour is outside the recipe contract.
approximations.tolerance: The blended underline colour may differ by a few 8-bit channel steps; the accent step selected per underline mode and contrast has no tolerance.
